name: CSN 319 一套液压系统失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 319, you are parking at gate 51, you have received information Charlie, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 319，停在 51 号登机口，已收到通播 Charlie，从武汉飞往广州，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN319, gate 51, information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN319，51 号登机口，通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36 right, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initially climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow LKO 01 departure, initially climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO 01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，CSN319。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, due to military activity, expect 1 hour delay, you are number 5 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，因军事活动，预计延误 1 小时，你是第 5 架离场。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN319, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN319，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, after Boeing 737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Zulu 4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，后方 Boeing 737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Zulu 4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: After B737 behind is clear, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 后方 B737 避让后，推出至滑行道 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头朝东，CSN319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, taxi to holding point runway 36 right via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha, hold short of runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待，CSN319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36 right, you are ready for takeoff, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好起飞，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN319, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN319，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, behind Boeing 737 on final, line up runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，在五边 Boeing 737 后，进入跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Behind B737 on final, line up runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在五边 B737 后，进入跑道 36R，CSN319。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN319。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, stop climbing due to converging traffic, level off at 2700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，因汇聚冲突飞机，停止爬升，在 2700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: Stop climb, level off at 2700 meters, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 停止爬升，在 2700 米改平，CSN319。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, continue climb to 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，继续爬升至 4500 米。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you found 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900 meters and then return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现 1 套液压系统失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，告知 ATC 该情况，并请求在 3900 米改平后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CSN319, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 3900 meters and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，CSN319，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 3900 米改平并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 319, roger PAN, maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 319，收到 PAN，保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，Lima Kilo Oscar 02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3900 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, LKO 02 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 3900 米，左转，直飞 LKO，LKO 02 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN319。

cards.audioText: B: A thunderstorm was detected near Lima Kilo Oscar, report it to Wuhan Approach and ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: B：Lima Kilo Oscar 附近探测到雷暴，向武汉进近报告并请求向左偏置 20 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN319, there is a thunderstorm near LKO, request offset 20 miles to the left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN319，LKO 附近有雷暴，请求向左偏置 20 海里。
